purpose: Preserve the hydrologically meaningful SWMAN=2 soil-state-driven surface-water management policy while moving surface-water state and hydraulic realization to Ribasim.

source_order: decrement by groundwater criterion while legacy condition applies
decrement by air-volume criterion while legacy condition applies
decrement by selected-pressure-head criterion while legacy condition applies
Q2A_POLICY.rate_policy: preserve explicit DROPR downward-target rule in a transaction-safe accepted interval; rejected trials may not alter accepted WLSTAR
tests: phase-selection edge cases for each hydraulic criterion
noncommensurate event scheduling through RM11/RM12 scheduler

Q2B_RIBASIM_REALIZATION.supply: allocation-controlled finite-capacity route representing available WSCAP-like supply
Q2B_RIBASIM_REALIZATION.discharge: allocation-controlled TabulatedRatingCurve with physical Q(h) as hard capacity
Q2B_RIBASIM_REALIZATION.route_policy: positive discharge route priority so surplus is removed only as needed after higher-priority level objectives
cases: below lower band with adequate supply
below lower band with insufficient supply
inside band with no management transfer
above upper band with sufficient discharge capacity
above upper band with insufficient physical Q(h) capacity

discrepancy_policy: Do not reproduce the documented legacy SWQHR1-current-WLS versus SWQHR2-target-WLSTAR automatic-capacity asymmetry as a hidden compatibility rule.
Use one explicit Ribasim physical-capacity definition and report the behavior change against the legacy discrepancy.
Do not allow uncommitted SWAP trial hydraulic state to select a management phase.
nonclaims: No claim that every legacy numerical timestep response is scientifically desirable.
No scarcity competition qualification beyond the later explicit Q2B cases.
